test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Runs scored by 5 boys R, B, C, L and Q are compared. Runs of no two boys are same. Runs of B are less than Q but more than C. Runs of L are more than R but less than C. How many boys scored runs more than L?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Runs of B are less than Q but more than C.

So, the order is: Q > B > C

Runs of L are more than R but less than C.

So, C > L > R

Combining both conditions: Q > B > C > L > R
